comment: THE ACTION TABLE (blueprint 7B/7D). The CLI is the only implementation; the OMP extension and the MCP server read this table to translate a tool call into CLI argv and add nothing else. A new action is one row here plus its case in core/cli.sh.

id.description: the instance id, a non-negative integer

adapter.description: force a surface adapter (see adapters/order); it must be available or the call is REFUSED ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE

size.description: WxH of the instance's screen, e.g. 1626x931

win.description: an X window id on the instance's display

title.description: a regex matched against window names to bind a window

x.description: x: window-relative pixels (X path) or page CSS pixels (CDP path)

key.description: a key name (xdotool keysym, or a CDP chord such as ctrl+a); for state_get/state_put, the row key

db.description: an explicit db path for state_put; it must be inside the instance root or the call is REFUSED SCOPE_VIOLATION

cmd.description: argv of the program to launch, one element per argument

cdp.description: a Chrome DevTools port: drive a browser in-process instead of through X

out.description: a file path for the screenshot

lines.description: how many scrollback lines terminal_read returns

orphans.description: shell_down: only compositors the registry lost

default.description: app_install: make this the instance's default application

confirm.description: view: REQUIRED - set only when the operator asked to see the instance; view raises a window on their screen
